injectCSS: body{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a0a0f 0%,#12121a 50%,#0a0a0f 100%)!important}section{border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,0.1),inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,255,255,0.02)!important;border:1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.2)!important;background:rgba(18,18,26,0.85)!important}section>h3.title:first-child{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,255,255,0.1),transparent)!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.3)!important;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,255,255,0.5)}section#main_shell{box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(0,255,255,0.15),inset 0 0 50px rgba(0,255,255,0.03)!important}ul#main_shell_tabs>li{border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;transition:all 0.3s ease}ul#main_shell_tabs>li:hover{background:rgba(0,255,255,0.1);box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,0.2)}ul#main_shell_tabs>li.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,255,255,0.2),transparent)!important;box-shadow:0 -2px 10px rgba(0,255,255,0.3)}div.keyboard_key{border-radius:4px!important;transition:all 0.15s ease!important;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)}div.keyboard_key:hover{box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,255,255,0.4)!important;transform:translateY(-1px)}div.keyboard_key.active{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,0.6)!important;background:rgba(0,255,255,0.3)!important}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#00ffff,#00cccc)!important}
